blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Townhomes in Maple Ridge sit only in the built-up south and growth areas, not the rural east.
The townhouse clusters a buyer will actually tour are Albion around 240 Street and 104 Avenue, Cottonwood around Kanaka Way and Cottonwood Drive, and Silver Valley around 232 Street and 136 Avenue.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Albion Station is at 10151 240 Street, Spencer Brook Estates at 23986 104 Avenue (strata plan EPS763, built 2015), and Rydge at 10640 248 Street has 61 townhomes by Raicon Developments, counted under Thornhill because the board classifies it there.

Cottonwood Terrace is at 11355 Cottonwood Drive and Carriage Lane at 11358 Cottonwood Drive; Brighton in Silver Valley is at 13819 232 Street (strata plan BCS3895, built 2011) and Windfall at 23183 136 Avenue was built in 2023.
Brookside Gardens at 20834 Dewdney Trunk Road looks like townhouse stock but is a 44-unit rental complex built in 1978, so there is nothing to buy there.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Townhouse zoning here is RM-1 (Low Density Townhouse Residential) under Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019. A City public-hearing notice rezoned 11646–11654 228 Street from RS-1 to RM-1 for an 8-unit market strata townhouse development, which shows the usual route for new townhouse sites.
Every complex above is strata, so the Form B Information Certificate, depreciation report and contingency reserve fund balance are the purchase documents; there is no Form B for a fee-simple home.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Fraserview Village buildings near 116 Avenue are apartments, not townhouses, even when a listing photo makes them look like ground-oriented homes.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: East Fern Townhouses, 24195 Fern Crescent, by Woodlock Developments Ltd.: 24 family-oriented townhouse units at 128th Street and Fern Crescent in Silver Valley, designed to the RM-1 Townhouse zone guide of 0.75 floor space ratio (FSR) and a 40 units per hectare limit; STATUS: rezoning and development permit review in the City's Advisory Design Panel material read on 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: For a multi-residential property the City's 2026 utility schedule lists a flat water fee of $815.62 and a flat sewer fee of $680.91, with metered customers billed quarterly.
Haney Place Exchange in the town centre is the hub for townhouse areas, with the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station and route 701 toward Coquitlam Central and Maple Ridge East.
Route 745 serves Cottonwood from Haney Place and route 746 serves Albion from Haney Place, which are the local links for the two biggest townhouse clusters.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Flood status is now governed by the City of Maple Ridge Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026, which designates floodplain in Schedule A and sets flood construction levels and setbacks; check a townhouse lot against Schedule A, especially near River Road and Port Haney.
The City states the new bylaw addresses the Fraser River, the Alouette River system, steep creeks such as Kanaka Creek, and groundwater flooding, and that a site-specific exemption process exists.
Silver Valley and Thornhill townhouse sites sit below hillside and creek areas, so the bylaw's Debris Flow and Alluvial Fan Hazard Area in Schedule A is the layer to check for a specific lot.

faq.a: That means a strata corporation, monthly strata fees, bylaws and a Form B Information Certificate on a purchase at complexes such as Spencer Brook Estates, 23986 104 Avenue, and Brighton, 13819 232 Street. A seller who says a townhome is fee-simple should be checked on the title search before subjects are removed.
faq.q: Are Maple Ridge townhomes strata or freehold?

faq.a: The board classification governs here, and Rydge at 10640 248 Street is classified Thornhill even though its developer marketed it as an Albion project. The practical point for a buyer is catchment, tax and comparable selection: use the Thornhill sub-area for Rydge, not Albion, and confirm the School District 42 catchment for the exact address in the district's school locator before writing an offer.
faq.q: Why is Rydge sometimes called Albion and sometimes Thornhill?

faq.a: Yes for long-term rentals, because British Columbia made residential rental-restriction bylaws in strata corporations void on November 24, 2022. A strata can still restrict short-term rentals by bylaw, so a buyer planning short stays must read the current bylaws for that complex, for example at Cottonwood Terrace, 11355 Cottonwood Drive, rather than relying on an old building summary that still says rentals are not allowed.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Maple Ridge townhome I buy?

faq.a: Haney Pioneer Village at 11830 230 Street is townhouse-shaped but is an 84-unit housing co-operative for seniors aged 60-plus, not a strata a buyer can purchase, and St. George's Village at 23580 Dewdney Trunk Road is also a co-operative. Buyers who need a strata purchase should look at Fraserview Village apartments instead.
